messages:
josh: Quick sync 90m plan for reducing telemetry spend from long-tail traces. Proposal: "adaptive cohorter" that combines route heatmaps + SLO budgets to pick full vs compact tracing. Thoughts?

maria: Sounds promising. can you outline the datapath and where we lose/gain info?

josh: Datapath sketch: edge profiler emits small fingerprint header -> cohorter (sidecar) consults heatmap + SLO budget -> tags trace as HOT/COLD/DEFERRED -> HOT: full spans + enrichment, COLD: compact envelope (span stubs + breadcrumb), DEFERRED: drop heavy metadata but keep billing breadcrumb. Key tradeoffs: storage/cost vs attribution fidelity and query rehydration latency. Pseudocode: 
```
score = heatmap.score(route) * recent_qps_weight
if score > HOT_T: mark('HOT')
elif score > COLD_T: mark('COLD')
else: mark('DEFERRED')
```

devon: ops worries: compact envelopes must still carry billing_key; if we hash and drop original, downstream joins might be fuzzy. how do we quantify attribution error?

josh: We'll store billing_key_hash + tenant_hint + a provenance token in every compact envelope. Billing pipeline will run a probabilistic join and emit an attribution_confidence metric per-aggregation. We'll also keep a small sample (1/1000) of full traces per route for verification.

lina: Rollout/backout playbook? If we trigger this we need fast signal detection and rollback automation.

josh: Canary plan: feature-flag by route percent. Metrics to monitor: per-route telemetry_unit_cost, cold_cohort_tail_latency_p95, billing_attr_mismatch_rate. If mismatch > 0.02 or cold_p95 grows > 10%, automatically reduce cohort aggressiveness. Example toggle: curl -XPOST "https://ops-api/flags?name=adaptive_cohort_v1&routes=1%25"

maria: I'll run an offline dry-run using 7 days of anonymized traces. compute per-route cost delta, attribution_confidence delta, and query error bounds. Spark job sketch: read traces -> simulate cohort decisions -> emit per-route metrics.

observability-bot: Created issue OBS-1203: "adaptive-cohorter follow-up" with subtasks: schema_compact_envelope, sidecar_poc, offline_sim, canary_playbook. Assigned to josh/maria/devon.

devon: Console UX: teams must see attr_confidence and a note if route uses compact envelopes. Suggest exposing a confidence score and sampling rate, plus a toggle to request rehydration queries (on-demand full fetch).

josh: Good. We'll add "attr_confidence" and "sample_rate" to route metadata and surface them in billing CSVs and Console. Also add a column for estimated_cost_savings_pct.

maria: Concern: pushing logic into SDKs increases upgrade surface. Implementation options: (1) lightweight SDK header only, (2) sidecar/proxy (preferred for controlled rollout), (3) ingress gateway (single control plane but latency concern). Recommend sidecar POC then revisit.

lina: Also document the math for probabilistic dedupe and expected query reconstruction error. teams will need that for compliance.

josh: Agreed 92 we'll add a short appendix to RFC with error bounds derivation and sample-weight calibration. Next steps: 1) josh updates RFC with compact-envelope schema + provenance token, 2) maria starts offline sim, 3) devon drafts Console fields and alerting, 4) prototype sidecar POC.

maria: Starting sim job tomorrow; will post results here.

devon: I'll add dashboard + alerts: attr_mismatch_rate > 0.02, cold_cohort_p95_delta > 10% and automatic rollback link.

observability-bot: Reminder 92 add to Obs-Arch sync Thu 10:00. Add to agenda? (yes/no)

josh: yes please.

lina: Thanks, short and actionable. :thumbsup:
